battle.name: 第五次反法同盟
battle.brief: 一八〇九年，拿破崙陷於半島戰爭泥淖，奧地利乘勢再舉反法旗幟。四月十日卡爾大公越境巴伐利亞，奧軍於阿斯珀恩-埃斯靈挫敗法軍，五月拿破崙攻入維也納，六月瓦格拉姆一役再決勝負。卡面火繩槍早已退出現役，方陣齊射的血統才是這場戰役的底色。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 一八〇九年的第五次反法同盟，是法蘭西帝國與以奧地利帝國為核心的聯盟在中歐的一場較量，主戰場在多瑙河谷與巴伐利亞。進攻方的實際主力是拿破崙直接指揮的法軍大軍團，幕僚與各軍團由參謀長路易-亞歷山大·貝爾蒂埃協調，編制上包括達武第三軍團、勒費弗爾的巴伐利亞軍團、馬塞納、烏迪諾、聖西爾、旺當姆所部與拉納的帝國衛隊，另有波拿波利率領的波蘭-薩克森軍團、貝西埃的騎兵預備隊，以及歐仁親王博哈奈斯在北義的義大利軍團；法國的衛星國巴伐利亞、薩克森、萊茵邦聯諸邦、華沙大公國與義大利王國各自供應人馬與基地。防守方是弗朗茨一世統治的哈布斯堡奧地利帝國，其陸軍在卡爾大公率領下編成五個軍團與兩個預備軍團：貝勒加德第一軍團約三萬八千人，科洛拉特第二軍團約兩萬人，霍亨索倫-黑欣根第三軍團、羅森伯格第四軍團與列支敦士登第一預備軍團合計約六萬六千人，路易大公第五軍團、希勒第六軍團與金邁耶第二預備軍團合計約六萬一千人。聯盟名單上的英國、葡萄牙、西班牙、薩丁尼亞與西西里多屬政治掛名：英國從未在德意志本土投入主力，薩丁尼亞與西西里實際未參戰。另有不倫瑞克公爵腓特烈·威廉率數千「黑不倫瑞克軍團」志願兵加入奧軍攻入薩克森。俄羅斯帝國是最微妙的第三方：塔列朗以俄國會援奧為由促其出兵，俄軍戈利岑中將六月三日進入加利西亞，卻奉命避免任何衝突，雙方幾乎未曾交火。
countriesEn: The Fifth Coalition of 1809 was a Central European confrontation between the French Empire and a coalition built around the Austrian Empire, fought in the Danube valley and in Bavaria. On the attacking side the real weight of force was the Grande Armée personally commanded by Napoleon, coordinated by chief of staff Louis-Alexandre Berthier, organised into Davout's III Corps, Lefebvre's Bavarian corps, the corps of Masséna, Oudinot, Saint-Cyr, Vandamme and Lannes' Imperial Guard, together with Poniatowski's Polish-Saxon corps, Bessières' cavalry reserve and Eugène de Beauharnais' Italian corps in northern Italy; France's satellite states — Bavaria, Saxony, the Confederation of the Rhine, the Grand Duchy of Warsaw and the Kingdom of Italy — supplied men and bases. The defending side was the Habsburg Austrian Empire under Francis I, whose army under the Archduke Charles was organised into five corps and two reserve corps: Bellegarde's I Corps at about 38,000 men, Kollowrat's II Corps at about 20,000, the central three corps of Hohenzollern-Hechingen, Rosenberg and Liechtenstein totalling about 66,000, and the left wing of Louis, Hiller and Klenau at about 61,000. Britain's role was largely nominal: it never landed main forces in Germany proper, and Sardinia and Sicily did not fight at all. The Duke of Brunswick led several thousand volunteers of the Black Brunswickers in the Austrian ranks into Saxony. Russia was the most paradoxical member: Talleyrand used the promise of Russian aid for Austria to prompt a Russian entry, but Golitsyn's corps crossed into Galicia on 3 June under orders to avoid any collision, and the two sides scarcely met.
people: 拿破崙在此役中同時是統帥與前線軍人。三月三十日他致信貝爾蒂埃，計劃在雷根斯堡附近集結十四萬人；四月十七日抵達多瑙沃特後接管指揮，二十一至二十二日以「蘭休特調動」完成側翼迂迴，二十二日率主力趕到埃克米爾解達武之圍。他並非沒有失誤：他把注意力集中在達武一個軍團上，嚴重低估卡爾大公五個軍團約八萬人越過伊薩爾河的人數；阿斯珀恩-埃斯靈之役中浮橋被奧軍火船燒毀、橋頭堡遭縱隊猛攻，他在右大腿被流彈擊傷，此役之後把戰役主導權交給拉納，自己退守洛鮑島重整渡河。卡爾大公是奧軍的靈魂：三十六歲，主張寧可犧牲戰線也不可放棄原則，力排眾議主張在巴伐利亞境內主攻而非退守波希米亞；他既不肯因宿怨解職才能不足的將領，又在埃克米爾與阿斯珀恩的關鍵時刻展現果斷。奧地利外長約翰·菲利普·斯塔基文是促成開戰的戰爭派領袖；駐法大使克萊門斯·梅特涅自一八〇八年赴任，是停戰與和約的主要談判者；法方元帥拉納、馬塞納、達武、旺當姆與近衛師長讓·拉普各統一軍；歐仁親王博哈奈斯掌北義戰線，布倫瑞克公爵帶兵攻入薩克森；提洛爾起義領袖安德烈斯·霍費爾是山中酒館主人，以民兵拖住法義聯軍至十一月；戈特契起義的領袖約翰·厄克則在戈特契的德裔聚居地號召抗法。
peopleEn: Napoleon was at once supreme commander and front-line soldier in this campaign. On 30 March he wrote to Berthier setting out a plan to concentrate 140,000 men near Regensburg; he reached Donauwörth on 17 April and took over the command, and on 21 and 22 April carried out the flank movement known as the Landshut Maneuver, arriving at Eckmühl on the 22nd to relieve Davout. He was not without error: he concentrated his attention on Davout's single corps and badly underrated the fact that five Austrian corps, some 80,000 men, had crossed the Isar. At Aspern-Essling the pontoon bridge was burned by Austrian boats and the bridgehead was overrun by massed columns; Napoleon himself was wounded in the right thigh by a stray bullet, and afterwards handed over the conduct of the battle to Lannes and withdrew to the Lobau island to reorganise the crossing. The Archduke Charles was the soul of the Austrian army: thirty-six years old, inclined to sacrifice ground rather than abandon principle, he outvoted the court war party and insisted on attacking in Bavaria rather than falling back into Bohemia; he would not dismiss incapable generals out of old grudges, yet showed decision at the critical moments of Eckmühl and Aspern. Johann Philipp Stadion, the Austrian foreign minister, headed the war party that pushed the country into the war; Klemens von Metternich, ambassador in Paris from 1808, conducted the armistice and peace negotiations. On the French side the marshals Lannes, Masséna, Davout and Vandamme and Jean Rapp, commanding a division of the Imperial Guard, each led an army corps; Eugène de Beauharnais held the Italian front and the Duke of Brunswick led his troops into Saxony. Andreas Hofer, an innkeeper who led the Tyrolean rising, held the French and Italian columns at bay until November, while Johann Erdmann called the German inhabitants of Gottschee to arms.
kits: 任務指定的火繩槍是十六世紀初的西班牙火繩步槍，到一八〇九年已是淘汰逾兩百年的老兵器，歐洲各國線列步兵裝備的是燧發槍，本役沒有任何一支主力部隊實際使用火繩槍作戰。但這件兵器確立的傳統卻整場戰役都在運作：肩射手持步槍、按班排成單縱隊、聽令齊射、裝填完畢後由後排補上——這套從火繩槍軍團開始的火力管理方式，到拿破崙時代仍是法奧兩軍的共同底層語言。火繩槍時代亦定型了方陣，即四面拒敵的密集隊形；拿破崙在四月十七日伊薩爾河戰線上就曾下令全軍以營方陣（bataillon carré）應對奧軍的進攻，到了瓦格拉姆之日，麥克唐納以中空方陣般的縱隊向奧軍中央猛攻，雖被砲火摧毀，仍靠人數厚度鑿穿防線，正是那種「以厚度換射擊量」的思路。真正上陣的步槍以法軍一八〇八年式燧發槍為代表，配刺刀可作長矛使用；奧軍同期的步兵槍是一八〇九年式燧發滑膛步槍，銅件、帶刺刀，並由輕步兵使用獵槍與短步槍。砲兵方面，法軍在阿斯珀恩-埃斯靈北岸僅有約一百五十二門野戰砲，瓦格拉姆卻在中央組成一百一十二門的「大砲列」；奧軍在五月廿一日以九萬八千人、五個縱隊、二百九十二門砲進攻渡口。奧軍幾乎沒有可快速機動的騎砲兵，砲兵多隸屬步兵指揮官；龐大的載貨列車既拖慢行軍，也令補給線長得驚人。
kitsEn: The matchlock musket named on the card face is a Spanish weapon of the early sixteenth century; by 1809 it was a relic more than two centuries out of date, and the line infantry of every European army carried flintlock muskets instead — no main body in this campaign ever fought with a matchlock. Yet the tradition the weapon established governed the whole battle: the shoulder-armed musket held in single files, the rank firing in unison, the file wheeling back to reload while the next line stepped up. That system of fire management, born with the matchlock regiments, was still the shared working language of the French and Austrian armies under Napoleon. The matchlock era also settled on the close-order square, the dense formation that faced the enemy on all four sides; on 17 April on the Isar line Napoleon ordered the whole army deployed as battalion squares (bataillon carré) to meet the Austrian attack, and by the day of Wagram Macdonald drove a hollow-square column at the Austrian centre, and although gunfire destroyed it, it still bored through the line by weight of numbers alone — precisely that exchange of thickness for volume of fire. The muskets actually in the ranks were represented on the French side by the Model 1808 flintlock musket, fitted with a bayonet that could be used as a pike, and on the Austrian side by the Model 1809 flintlock smoothbore musket, brass-mounted and bayoneted, with light infantry carrying hunting rifles and short muskets. In the artillery arm, the French had only about 152 field guns on the north bank at Aspern-Essling, but at Wagram they massed a grand battery of 112 guns in the centre, while the Austrians attacked the bridgehead on 21 May with 98,000 men in five columns and 292 guns. The Austrian artillery had almost no horse batteries for rapid manoeuvre and was subordinated to the infantry commanders, and the enormous baggage trains slowed their marching and stretched the supply lines to a punishing length.
tactics: 奧軍的戰術起點是主動出擊：在拿破崙被半島戰爭拖住時，卡爾大公以五個軍團自波希米亞與格拉茨兩路越境巴伐利亞，尋求在俄軍尚未決定參戰之前打成一個決戰；多瑙河被用來分割敵我，因此奧廷兩派曾為主攻方向爭論近一個月，最終選擇南岸進攻以保證與維也納的聯繫。行軍極慢、縱隊密集，全軍靠大型載貨列車補給，機動性先天不足。法軍的應對則是一連串強行軍與側翼運作：四月二十一日馬塞納軍團由多瑙河南岸急行軍攻取蘭休特，隔日經阿巴赫直趨雷根斯堡，迫使奧軍放棄對達文的攻擊並向多瑙河退卻，這就是「蘭休特調動」；四月二十三日拉納強攻雷根斯堡城牆得手，五月十三日法軍進入維也納，五月廿一日渡河嘗試在維也納北面的凱撒-艾伯斯多夫架設浮橋，卻遭奧軍火船燒毀橋身，橋頭堡阿斯珀恩與埃斯靈在三天內數度易手，浮橋兩次被毀令法軍主力遲遲無法過河。瓦格拉姆一役，馬塞納在左翼奪取利奧波德與素森布呂恩，達武以數個師自北面迂迴，貝納多特擅自撤出阿德克拉村中心暴露法軍縱隊，拿破崙遂以一百一十二門砲組成的大砲列壓制奧軍中央，又派馬塞納的莫利托師與南索蒂的四千胸甲騎兵反覆爭奪村莊；卡爾大公本欲以鉗形攻勢夾擊，卻因子弟約翰大公的部隊尚在數公里外而無法同時到位，午後下令全線撤退。
tacticsEn: The Austrian plan began with an offensive of their own: while Napoleon was bogged down in the Peninsular War, the Archduke Charles crossed into Bavaria with five corps by two routes out of Bohemia and Graz, seeking a decisive battle before Russia had decided what to do; the Danube was used to divide the two sides, so the court and the command disagreed for close to a month over the axis of the attack, and the southern route was finally chosen to keep contact with Vienna. Marching was slow, columns were dense, and the whole army depended on huge baggage trains for supply, so mobility was structurally weak. The French answer was a chain of forced marches and flank operations: on 21 April Masséna's corps hurried up the south bank of the Danube to seize Landshut, and next day pushed through Abensberg towards Regensburg, forcing the Austrians to abandon the attack on Davout and fall back towards the Danube — this was the Landshut Maneuver; on 23 April Lannes stormed the walls of Regensburg, the French entered Vienna on 13 May, and on 21 May an attempt was made to bridge the Danube at Kaiser-Eibsdorf north of Vienna, but Austrian fire-boats burned the bridge away. Aspern and Essling changed hands repeatedly over three days, and the pontoon bridge was destroyed twice, keeping the French masses from crossing. At Wagram, Masséna took Leopold and Süssenbrunn on the left, Davout drove several divisions round the northern flank, and Bernadotte withdrew from the centre of Aderklaa of his own accord, exposing the French columns; Napoleon answered with the grand battery of 112 guns pressed against the Austrian centre and sent Morilot's division of Masséna's corps together with Nansouty's four thousand cuirassiers to fight again and again for the villages. Charles had planned a pincer movement, but it could not be launched because his brother John was still several kilometres away, and in the afternoon he ordered a general retreat.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。法軍自德意志抽調十萬八千人往西班牙，兵力的重心因此不在萊茵；拿破崙三月三十日致貝爾蒂埃的信中計劃在雷根斯堡附近集結十四萬人，至瓦格拉姆前線橫渡多瑙河的部隊已超過十八萬八千人。奧軍方面，貝勒加德第一軍團約三萬八千人、科洛拉特第二軍團約兩萬人、中路三個軍團合計約六萬六千人、左翼三個軍團合計約六萬一千人。四月二十日阿本斯貝格之役，奧軍損失約一萬人，折損三十門砲、六百箱彈藥與約七千輛車。埃克米爾之役，拿破崙投入的援軍使法軍總數約三萬六千人，而面對的奧軍約七萬五千人；四月二十一日已有五個奧軍軍團約八萬人越過伊薩爾河。五月廿一日卡爾大公以九萬八千人、五個縱隊與二百九十二門砲進攻法軍橋頭堡；廿二日法軍北岸約七萬一千人、一百五十二門砲。瓦格拉姆，法軍損失約三萬二千人，四十名將軍戰死或受傷，奧軍損失約三萬五千人；七月十日至十一日茲奈姆一帶再交火，七月十二日簽署停戰協定。英軍在瓦爾赫倫島登陸的部隊超過三萬九千人，因「瓦爾赫倫熱」病亡約四千人，戰鬥中陣亡僅一百零六人，遠征軍自九月七日開始撤退、守軍維持至十二月九日。普魯士在一八〇九年四月被課以一億四千萬法郎賠款，軍隊限額四萬二千人。奧地利獲英國二十五萬英鎊白銀援助，另有百萬英鎊承諾待用。《申布倫條約》規定奧地利支付近八千五百萬法郎賠償，割讓薩爾斯堡、西提洛爾、克恩頓、卡尼奧拉及亞得里亞海諸港，並向法國交出約三百萬人口，約佔全國人口五分之一。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. France had withdrawn 108,000 men from Germany to Spain, so the weight of force was not on the Rhine; in his letter of 30 March to Berthier, Napoleon planned to concentrate 140,000 men near Regensburg, and by the time the army crossed the Danube before Wagram more than 188,000 troops had gone over. On the Austrian side, Bellegarde's I Corps numbered about 38,000, Kollowrat's II Corps about 20,000, the three central corps together about 66,000, and the three left-wing corps about 61,000. At Abensberg on 20 April the Austrians lost about 10,000 men, thirty guns, six hundred boxes of ammunition and some seven thousand vehicles. At Eckmühl, Napoleon's reinforcements brought the French total to about 36,000 against roughly 75,000 Austrians, and by 21 April five Austrian corps of about 80,000 men had crossed the Isar. On 21 May Charles advanced with 98,000 men in five columns and 292 guns against the French bridgehead; on the 22nd the French had about 71,000 men and 152 guns on the north bank. At Wagram the French lost about 32,000 men, with forty generals killed or wounded, and the Austrians about 35,000; there was further fighting around Schönbrunn on 10 and 11 July, and the armistice was signed on 12 July. The British force that landed on Walcheren numbered over 39,000 men; about 4,000 died of the Walcheren fever while only 106 were killed in action, and the expedition began withdrawing on 7 September, the garrison remaining until 9 December. Prussia was charged an indemnity of 140 million francs in April 1809 and had its army limited to 42,000 men. Austria received 250,000 pounds sterling in silver from Britain, with a further million promised for future use. The Treaty of Schönbrunn required Austria to pay nearly 85 million francs in compensation and to cede Salzburg, West Tyrol, Carniola, Carinthia and the Adriatic ports, handing over about three million people, close to a fifth of the empire's population.
cause: 開戰有三重原因疊加。第一是領土與王位尊嚴：一八〇五年《普雷斯堡和約》之後，奧地利先後失去提洛、威尼斯與亞得里亞海岸的出海口，哈布斯堡王朝在德意志與義大利的既存權益被拿破崙逐漸掏空；一八〇八年拿破崙廢黜西班牙波旁王室、改立其兄約瑟夫·波拿巴，奧地利朝廷視之為對正統原則的最後挑戰，認為容忍即等於坐看哈布斯堡崩解。第二是戰略時機：拿破崙在西班牙泥淖裏被游擊戰拖住，法軍精銳大量滯留半島，維也納朝廷判斷此時用兵比再等兩年更有勝算。第三是外交上的錯覺與隨後的崩解：奧地利期待普魯士再度入伙，卻在一八〇九年被《巴黎公約》限制為四萬二千人的軍隊並課以巨額賠款；俄羅斯雖在提爾西特條約上屬於法國同盟，卻只答應「慢行進入奧國境內而避免一切衝突」，戈利岑中將的軍隊在加利西亞幾乎是象徵性的存在。於是聯盟在名義上成立、在實力上卻幾乎全靠奧地利一家承擔，這正是卡爾大公在阿斯珀恩-埃斯靈能以九萬八千人孤立法軍的原因。
causeEn: Three causes were layered together. The first was territory and the dignity of crowns: after the Peace of Pressburg in 1805 Austria had lost Tyrol, Venetia and its outlet on the Adriatic, and the Habsburg's existing rights in Germany and Italy were steadily hollowed out by Napoleon. In 1808 the deposition of the Spanish Bourbons and the seating of Napoleon's brother Joseph on the throne was treated in Vienna as the last challenge to the principle of legitimacy, and tolerating it was judged equivalent to watching the Habsburgs collapse. The second was opportunity: with the French tied down in Spain and much of the army's strength stranded on the peninsula, the Viennese court judged that fighting was more likely to succeed than waiting another two years. The third was diplomatic miscalculation and its immediate collapse: Austria expected Prussia to come in again, but in 1809 the Convention of Paris capped the Prussian army at 42,000 men and loaded it with a heavy indemnity, while Russia, though bound to France by the Treaty of Tilsit, undertook only to advance slowly into Austrian territory while avoiding all collision and hostilities, and Golitsyn's corps in Galicia was close to symbolic. The coalition thus existed in name but in practice rested on Austria alone, which is exactly why Charles could face the French alone with 98,000 men at Aspern-Essling.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠超中歐本身。軍事上，奧地利幾乎退出歐洲強權競逐：拿破崙迎娶奧皇之女瑪麗·路易絲，以婚姻綁定法奧關係，奧地利加入大陸封鎖體系並在往後數年向法方提供兵力，這條紐帶在拿破崙兵敗俄國後被奧廷自己剪斷，一八一三年奧地利重新加入反法同盟，幾乎是對一八〇九年的清算。政治上，帝國朝廷的威信掃地，軍隊在編制、裝備、指揮與後勤上的落後被全歐看在眼裡，改革因此被迫加速。起義與騷動在戰時第一次大規模湧出：提洛爾有安德烈斯·霍費爾領導的武裝起義抵抗巴伐利亞接管，威尼斯地區有反對法國稅收與徵兵的騷動，戈特契有德裔居民的叛亂，約翰·厄克一度攻入市區；九月間更出現弗里德里希·斯塔普斯在閱兵時企圖刺殺拿破崙的事件，雖被近衛軍阻止，卻說明佔領下的德意志已不再是順民。軍事學上，這一役常被視為近代化戰爭的樣本：兵員規模空前膨脹，指揮權下放到軍團一級，勝負不再由一兩天的會戰決定，而由後勤、徵兵與消耗決定；英格倫因此把一八〇九年視為「第一場近代戰爭」。戰術教訓同樣殘酷：法軍在西歐的老兵比例下降，步兵戰術退化，麥克唐納在瓦格拉姆以中空方陣硬衝中央防線，正是靠厚度代替機動的反證。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond Central Europe. Militarily, Austria was pushed almost out of the European great-power contest: Napoleon married the emperor's daughter Marie-Louise, tying Austria to France by a dynastic knot; Austria joined the Continental System and supplied troops to the French in the years that followed, and that thread was cut by Vienna itself after Napoleon's defeat in Russia, when Austria rejoined the coalition in 1813 — a sort of reckoning with 1809. Politically the court lost its prestige, and the backwardness of the army in organisation, equipment, command and supply was visible to all of Europe, forcing reform forward. Uprisings and disturbances broke out on an unprecedented scale during the war: the armed rising led by Andreas Hofer in Tyrol against the transfer of the province to Bavaria; disturbances in the Venetian lands against French taxation and conscription; a revolt by the German inhabitants of Gottschee under Johann Erdmann, who entered the town; and in September the attempt of Friedrich Stapel to stab Napoleon during a review, frustrated by the Guard but a sign that Germany under occupation was no longer docile. In the history of war the campaign is often treated as a model of modern war: the scale of the armies grew without precedent, command was delegated down to the corps, and the outcome was no longer decided by one or two days of battle but by logistics, conscription and expenditure of material — which is why Englund called 1809 the first modern war. The tactical lesson was equally harsh: with fewer veterans from the western campaigns, French infantry declined in tactical quality, and Macdonald's hollow square charging the Austrian centre at Wagram is the proof of thickness being used in place of manoeuvre.
result: 結果是法國的戰略勝利與奧地利的出局。五月二十二日卡爾大公在阿斯珀恩-埃斯靈迫使拿破崙退守洛鮑島，這是拿破崙一生首場正面大敗，也讓全歐第一次相信他並非不可戰勝；但五週之後的七月五日至六日，瓦格拉姆的判決徹底改寫戰局：法軍以掩護射擊、迂迴與中央砲列同時壓上，奧軍被分割成數段，卡爾大公在約翰大公無法及時到位的情況下下令全線撤退。七月十二日《茲奈姆停戰協定》生效，戰爭事實上結束；十月十四日《申布倫條約》簽訂，奧地利割地、賠款，剝奪進入地中海的通道，帝國人口流失約五分之一，軍隊規模被大幅削減，而拿破崙與瑪麗·路易絲的婚姻則把這份屈服包裝成聯姻。聯盟的其他戰線同樣瓦解：英軍的瓦爾赫倫遠征因港口攻不下與疫病而全軍撤回，英國政局因此更迭；俄羅斯始終避免與奧地利交鋒；普魯士保持中立；西班牙與葡萄牙的抵抗在半島繼續拖延法軍。唯一被壓制而未成功的是提洛爾、威尼斯與戈特契的起義——它們在軍事上失敗，在政治上卻預告了後來德意志與義大利民族主義的抬頭，也預示了拿破崙體系的崩解倒數。
resultEn: The result was a French strategic victory and Austria's exclusion from the war. On 22 May the Archduke Charles forced Napoleon back to the island of Lobau at Aspern-Essling — the first outright defeat of Napoleon's career, and the moment when all Europe first believed that he could be beaten. Five weeks later, on 5 and 6 July, the verdict of Wagram rewrote the war entirely: the French pressed home with covering fire, envelopment and a grand battery in the centre all at once, the Austrian army was cut into several segments, and with his brother John unable to arrive in time Charles ordered a general retreat. The Armistice of Schönbrunn took effect on 12 July and the war was over in all but name; on 14 October the Treaty of Schönbrunn was signed, Austria ceding territory and paying compensation, losing its access to the Mediterranean, shedding about a fifth of its population and having its army sharply reduced, while the marriage to Marie-Louise packaged that humiliation as a union. The other fronts of the coalition collapsed as well: the Walcheren expedition was withdrawn entire because the port could not be taken and disease had thinned the army, bringing down a British ministry; Russia avoided contact with Austria throughout; Prussia stayed neutral; and the resistance in Spain and Portugal continued to tie down French forces on the peninsula. The risings in Tyrol, Venetia and Gottschee were the one thing suppressed without success: they failed militarily, but politically they foreshadowed the rise of German and Italian nationalism and, with them, the countdown to the collapse of Napoleon's system.
